offering_description.value: Sells cannabis products through its own dispensaries to adults and medical cannabis patients. It grows cannabis and manufactures packaged products for its stores and for wholesale sales to licensed dispensaries.

primary_products.value: Cannabis flower; pre-rolls; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates

customer_segment.value: B2C: Adult-use cannabis consumers and medical cannabis patients; B2B: Licensed third-party cannabis dispensaries

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retail and wholesale sales of cannabis flower and manufactured cannabis products

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sells in-house and third-party cannabis products to adults and patients; OEM / manufacturer: Grows cannabis and processes it into packaged products for its stores and licensed retailers; distributor: Supplies its packaged cannabis products to licensed third-party dispensaries

geography_served.value: US national: Licensed state markets across the Midwest, Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, South and West

specialization.value: related lines: Cannabis dispensaries, cultivation and manufacturing of packaged cannabis products

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated medical and adult-use cannabis dispensaries; third-party retail: Licensed dispensaries that stock its cannabis products; direct sales: Wholesale sales to licensed dispensary operators; online: Online ordering through its dispensary websites
distribution_channels.category: own locations; third-party retail; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State cannabis agencies license cultivation, processing and retail, and federal controlled-substance rules also apply.
